source_title: How your data is used to improve model performance
summary: Official help states individual ChatGPT/Codex content may be used for training unless the user opts out; Business, Enterprise, Edu and API data are not used for training by default.
caveat: Training controls and product terms can change and personal opt-out is not zero retention.
